title: “BSB Innovation Award 2026” ICHIMARU PHARCOS Honored with BSB Award for Environment / Raw Materials “Active”
summary: ICHIMARU PHARCOS Co., Ltd. (Headquarters: Gifu Prefecture,Japan) is delighted to announce that our revolutionary HappiClov, a natural active ingredient for cheek micro-lift, has been honored with BSB Innovation Award 2026 in the section of Refined & Revitalized Skin Appearance, Cellular Osmoregulation, Skin Elasticity under the category of Environment / Raw Materials, Active
